review_note: Independent theorem-only proof-safe review of pinned hypercovering.tex L1611 and Stage A logical fields: Adjoining one nondegenerate simplex to a finite simplicial diagram forces one matching-object filling condition; by the hypercover condition the induced Hom(V,K)_0→Hom(U,K)_0 is a covering. All combinatorial assumptions and finiteness survive.
statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site with fibre products.
Let $X$ be an object of $\mathcal{C}$.
Let $K$ be a hypercovering of $X$.
Let $U \subset V$ be simplicial sets, with $U_n, V_n$
finite nonempty for all $n$.
Assume that $U$ has finitely many nondegenerate simplices.
Suppose $n \geq 0$ and $x \in V_n$,
$x \not \in U_n$ are such that
\begin{enumerate}
\item $V_i = U_i$ for $i < n$,
\item $V_n = U_n \cup \{x\}$,
\item any $z \in V_j$, $z \not \in U_j$ for $j > n$
is degenerate.
\end{enumerate}
Then the morphism
$$
\Hom(V, K)_0
\longrightarrow
\Hom(U, K)_0
$$
of $\text{SR}(\mathcal{C}, X)$ is a covering.

review_note: Independent theorem-only proof-safe review of pinned hypercovering.tex L1697 and Stage A logical fields: Hypercovering local matching surjections imply every level K_n covers X and every face map d_i^n covers K_{n-1}, by stability under pullback and composition of covering families. The index ranges n≥1 and 0≤i≤n remain.
statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site with fibre products. Let $X$ be an object of
$\mathcal{C}$. Let $K$ be a hypercovering of $X$. Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item $K_n$ is a covering of $X$ for each $n \geq 0$,
\item $d^n_i : K_n \to K_{n - 1}$ is a covering for all $n \geq 1$
and $0 \leq i \leq n$.
\end{enumerate}
